description: Start-here guide served by the default nemo_discover answer, one list of steps per document kind. Each step names one operation with the smallest request that is valid for it. Tokens: payload value "$revision" is replaced by the open document's current revision, "<documentSnapshotId>" and "<layerUid>" stay for the client to fill from an earlier step. `expectedRevision: true` adds the current revision to the request envelope (commands carry it, reads never do). Every example is validated against the request schema by a test, and every operation must be declared by a registered capability.
notes: Reads carry atRevision (the current revision) and, after the pin step, documentSnapshotId; they never carry expectedRevision.

atRevision and the pin are valid only for the current revision. Every command and every project.open changes it, so repeat the pin step (and use the new revision) before each read that follows a command or an open; a read at an older revision or pin is refused as stale_revision. Example: set a value, repeat pin, read it back, set again, repeat pin, read it back.

Commands carry expectedRevision (the revision returned by your previous command or read). Every request needs a requestId that is new: the ids in these steps (pin-1, read-property-1) are examples, change them for each request you send.
project.open replaces the open document: documentId and revision change, so call nemo_discover again afterwards and use the identity it returns.
A refusal names the operation to use instead when the one you called does not apply to the open document.

object.title: Object document (the project kind the app opens today)

steps.purpose: Orient: documentId, revision, current frame, totalFrames, canvas size and the layer list (layer id is the layerUid).
Take the snapshot pin: result.documentSnapshotId, plus the presented contextId and frame. Property and history reads need it; take a new one after every command or open.
List the objects and properties that can be read, a page at a time (offset, limit).
Read a property at a frame (opacity is on a 0..100 scale): result.value. Needs a current pin. Other views: authoredKeys, expressionSource.
Edit a property: setValue, setKey, setAnimated, setExpression. One history entry, revision +1.
Undo the last history entry (payload steps: N jumps back N entries). Revision +1.
Redo the last undone entry. Revision +1.
Read undoDepth and redoDepth of the open document. Needs a current pin.
Save the open document to an absolute path.
Open another project file (refused when it is the file already open, and while the open project has unsaved changes). Then call nemo_discover again: the documentId and revision change.
Export frames as png, svg or lottie into an absolute destination.
Orient: documentId, revision, frame and the layer list.
Read the static opacity of a layer (0..100): result.value.
Set the static opacity (0..100) of a layer. Revision +1.
Undo the last edit.
Redo the last undone edit.
Save the open document to an absolute path.
Open another project file; then call nemo_discover again.
Export frames as png, svg or lottie into an absolute destination.
Open a project file; then call nemo_discover again.
Create a new blank project; then call nemo_discover again.

capabilities.purpose: Read the operations the open document answers on the apiVersion 1 route.

snapshot.purpose: Read documentId, revision, frame, size and layers of the open document.

property.get.purpose: Read a registered property (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

property.set.purpose: Set a registered property (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

property.key.set.purpose: Set a key of a registered property (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

property.key.remove.purpose: Remove a key of a registered property (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

property.animation.set.purpose: Turn a registered property animation on or off (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

history.undo.purpose: Undo the last edit (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

history.redo.purpose: Redo the last undone edit (apiVersion 1; opacity documents only).

project.open.purpose: Open a project file by absolute path (any document kind).

project.new.purpose: Create a blank project of a given size and frame rate (any document kind).

project.saveAs.purpose: Save the open project to an absolute path (any document kind).

project.export.purpose: Export frames as png, svg or lottie (any document kind).
